Asset credits

Original creators and licenses for the city and faction artwork used in this mockup.

Current city map

Mapbox Streets v8 supplies real vector roads, parks, water and building footprints. Its native attribution remains visible on the map. ZONE projects its fictional game services and authoritative ownership into a compact district; those services do not describe real businesses.

Map source · Projection and provider attribution

Tilted-view service landmarks: Kay Lousberg, KayKit City Builder Bits 1.0, CC0. Five bounded service scenes use this kit at game destination coordinates. Models are cosmetic and do not alter ownership or interaction geometry. Background building display heights are capped at 18 meters.

Asset collection · Included license

Faction emblems

Snake, Crown, Moon and Checked Shield icons made by Lorc. Available on Game-icons.net, under CC BY 3.0. The original SVGs are unmodified; display styling is applied by ZONE.

These symbols represent fictional mockup factions: Sand Vipers, Harbor Kings, Night Market and Old Guard.

Rendering

Three.js 0.184.0 by the Three.js authors, MIT license. Mapbox attribution is displayed on the map.

Three.js license · Full attribution record

Character wardrobe

Suit, Casual Hoodie and SWAT by Quaternius, Ultimate Modular Men Pack. CC0 1.0 Universal. Converted from original glTF to GLB; authored meshes and 24 skeletal animations per model retained. ZONE adapts material colors, lighting, framing and weapon attachments.

Original pack · Included license

Game navigation icons

Icons made by Lorc and Delapouite. Available on Game-icons.net, licensed under CC BY 3.0. Original SVGs are retained; ZONE supplies colored masks and metal tile treatment.

Weapon models

51 gameplay weapon IDs use 20 explicitly named CC0 source models. Repeated fictional variants are disclosed as source reuse, not new meshes. LonesomeDucky: Old Wooden Baseball Bat, Weathered AKM, Detective Special Revolver and Derringer Pistol. khairul169: M9 Knife. Those five accepted model files, author textures and grip descriptors remain unchanged.

3DModelsCC0: Makarov, Luger, AK47, M4A1, Grease Gun, Suomi KP, pump shotgun and scoped rifle, with their actual textured surfaces. loafbrr_1: six-shot revolver with original author PBR maps; scene ammunition and ground are excluded from the static gun display.

Tabasco: L85A1, G3A3, M1911, Mosin 9130 and Dragunov geometry. ZONE adapts their original color materials into readable blued steel and dark matte polymer; wood uses retained CC0 LonesomeDucky bat color/normal detail with projected UVs and walnut tint. These are declared surface adaptations, not original Tabasco colors or PBR maps.

JeanPFP: genuine double-barrel geometry with ZONE material adaptation. Original photographic atlas is excluded; safe retained CC0 LonesomeDucky wood maps and physical steel replace it. This compact fictional representation is not asserted to be an exact real-world sawed-off replica. Quaternius and the earlier Polyy source assets remain retained archive/recovery sources, not default gameplay presentation. All game prices, damage and rules remain server-owned and unchanged.

تستخدم معرفات الأسلحة الـ51 في اللعبة 20 نموذجاً أصلياً مسمى بوضوح بترخيص CC0. بعض الأنواع الخيالية تعيد استخدام المصدر نفسه، ولا تُحسب كنماذج أصلية جديدة. LonesomeDucky: المضرب الخشبي وAKM ومسدسا Detective Special وDerringer. khairul169: سكين M9. ملفات هذه النماذج الخمسة وخاماتها الأصلية وقياسات القبضة لم تتغير.

3DModelsCC0: نماذج Makarov وLuger وAK47 وM4A1 وGrease Gun وSuomi KP والبندقية الخرطوشية وبندقية القنص، بخامات المصدر الفعلية. loafbrr_1: مسدس دوار بست طلقات بخامات PBR الأصلية؛ لا تظهر ذخيرة المشهد وأرضيته في عرض السلاح الثابت.

Tabasco: هندسة L85A1 وG3A3 وM1911 وMosin 9130 وDragunov. تعدّل ZONE المواد اللونية الأصلية إلى فولاذ أزرق داكن وبوليمر مطفي. يستخدم الخشب تفاصيل لون وملمس المضرب الأصلي المرخص CC0 من LonesomeDucky مع إحداثيات UV وإضفاء لون الجوز. هذه تعديلات موثقة وليست خامات PBR الأصلية للمؤلف.

JeanPFP: الهندسة الأصلية للسلاح ثنائي الماسورة مع تعديل مواد ZONE. تُستبعد الصور الفوتوغرافية الأصلية وتُستخدم خامات الخشب الآمنة المرخصة CC0 من LonesomeDucky مع فولاذ فيزيائي. هذا تمثيل خيالي مدمج، وليس ادعاءً بنسخة مطابقة لسلاح حقيقي مقصوص الماسورة. تبقى أصول Quaternius وPolyy السابقة محفوظة للأرشيف والاستعادة، ولا تُعرض كأسلحة اللعب الافتراضية. أسعار الأسلحة والضرر والقواعد لم تتغير ويحددها الخادم.

Expanded weapon model library

424 distinct weapon geometries from 39 CC0 source collections, including firearms, melee weapons, bows, explosives and complete emplacements. The source library is separate from the fitted gameplay equipment. Each model retains its author, source, license and geometry fingerprint.

Character setting materials

Brick Wall 04 by Dario Barresi, Dimitrios Savva and Rico Cilliers, and Concrete Floor 02 by Rob Tuytel, from Poly Haven. CC0 1.0 Universal. Original ZONE staging geometry uses their photographed diffuse, normal and roughness maps.

Retired original ZONE city atlas

The retained procedural city atlas contains 5,553 rooftops, street markings, yards and lights. It is legacy source artwork and is not rendered by the current vector map.

Legacy atlas provenance

Original property and combat presentation

Seven original fictional property environments generated for ZONE on 10 October 2026. The unchanged atlas uses CSS tile positioning; it represents housing types, never ownership or engine state. Combat uses the credited wardrobe and photographed materials, with three original opt-in PCM cues. Opponent appearance is representative.
